thread:
emily.marketing: Heads-up team 111 we need a coordinated plan for customer comms + outbound channels for the embeddings degradation. Priorities: status page wording, in-product banner, social cadence (hold vs post), inbound ticket triage, and whether to postpone the benchmarking announcement/webinar. Thoughts?

sam.social: I wouldn't publish any benchmark or launch posts while this is unresolved. Even if only a subset impacted, perception on socials will be bad. Recommend hold on all outbound public marketing until we have a clear scope.

frank.support: Support is already seeing duplicates of "embeddings failing" tickets. Need a canned response + routing rules so high-value customers get account manager attention. Also, would help if marketing provides a short FAQ and expected next steps we can paste into replies.

zoe.evangelist: Suggest we prepare a short landing page that aggregates: status, impact, workarounds, and how well update customers. This can be used for email, support, and social once we're ready. Also propose a 30-min post-incident webinar for customers to walk through what happened and mitigation steps.

nina.sales: Sales: please flag any accounts with active pilots or contracts. If theyre impacted we need to trigger AE outreach. We prefer receiving the affected-list from incident tooling but will take manual flags if needed. Also, please prepare a short SLA-friendly email template for enterprise customers.

incident-bot: [incident] degraded-embeddings detected at 1991234499  severity: medium  current mitigation: fallback routing enabled.

emily.marketing: Draft status page copy (short):
```
Were seeing degraded performance for embeddings for a subset of requests. An automatic fallback is in place to reduce impact. Were investigating and will post updates here. Text generation endpoints are unaffected.
```

sam.social: Draft social note (hold): "We're aware of a service issue affecting embeddings for a subset of customers. We're investigating and will share updates on our status page. We are not publishing benchmark or product launch posts until this is resolved." Keep short.

zoe.evangelist: In-product banner candidate: "Embeddings service: degraded for some requests. See status page for details." Link to status.

frank.support: Canned support reply: "Thanks for reporting. We are aware of degraded embeddings for some requests. Please confirm whether this affects production ranking or search. If yes, reply with account ID and we'll escalate."

nina.sales: Enterprise outreach subj: "Notice: temporary impact on embeddings — were prioritizing your account" Body: "Your account may be affected by a temporary embeddings degradation. Were working on mitigation; your AE will reach out if youre impacted. Contact us at <link> for immediate assistance."

emily.marketing: Timeline decisions: publish status page + in-product banner now, do NOT post to social yet, and do NOT send mass email. Support and Sales will use canned replies. We'll generate a targeted email list from incident tooling and send individualized emails 30200 minutes after we confirm impact. Also pause benchmark tweets and the scheduled webinar until we can reframe messaging.

sam.social: Agree. Also recommend we draft a short message for partners/press in case they ask. Keep it factual.

zoe.evangelist: Webinar plan: tentatively move the webinar to 2 weeks out and title it "Incident review + reliability improvements" to be transparent. Marketing can recycle the hero content once we have a solid postmortem.

frank.support: I'll add the canned reply to support macros and route any ticket with keyword "embeddings" to P1 queue. Also will compile a list of affected accounts from logs and share with Nina.

emily.marketing: Action list (assign):
- sam.social: prep social hold message & partner brief (now)
- liam.sre (cced): confirm whether fallback affects accuracy vs latency and share affected-percentage (ASAP)
- frank.support: add support macro and compile initial affected-account list (30m)
- zoe.evangelist: draft webinar hold copy and landing page skeleton (today)
- nina.sales: prepare enterprise outbound template and monitor affected list

nina.sales: I'll stand by for the list. Also want to know if we should proactively reach out to customers on trials. We prefer to prioritize revenue-impacting accounts.

emily.marketing: Priority order: 1) customers in active pilots or enterprise contracts 2) customers with >$X/mo spend 3) open trials. We'll share thresholds in the next message.

sam.social: Posted hold drafts to the marketing content folder. Keeping them private for now.

liam.sre: Confirmed: fallback trades off some embedding fidelity for availability; currently ~9% of requests hit degraded path. No ETA yet. Will update when canary completes.

emily.marketing: Good. Once we have the final numbers we'll trigger targeted outreach flow. Well also note on the status page that "we will notify affected customers directly" to reduce inbound. Good work team.

frank.support: Adding macro now. Ping me if you want wording changes.

zoe.evangelist: I'll draft the webinar notification to attendees and a transparency outline. We'll be transparent about what happened and what we learned.

emily.marketing: Thanks everyone. Will consolidate final copy and post status + banner. We will reconvene after liam's canary update.
